1263-4871-5670-6634.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-4871-5670-6634.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7175-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
3259-7175-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7175-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

864-5531-5694-6763-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
864-5531-5694-6763-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Eternal Witness and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Eternal Witness and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
864-5531-5694-6763-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Eternal Witness and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

3327-4549-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
3327-4549-8095.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Dargo, adding {R}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

3317-3899-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3317-3899-5972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1379-5686-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
1379-5686-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Shilgengar.

431-4772-6753-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-4772-6753-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-6822-7741.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Shang-Chi
Repeat.

112-2103-7757.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn with {3}{U} each extra turn
112-2103-7757.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
112-2103-7757.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Capture of Jingzhou's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Capture of Jingzhou and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Capture of Jingzhou's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

1144-2645-5227-6871.easyPrerequisites: Utopia Sprawl is attached to Staff of Domination and has "Green" chosen.
1144-2645-5227-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {G} as it's a Forest land due to Toph and Yavimaya.
Utopia Sprawl triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

5231-6461--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1636-3634-6972.notablePrerequisites: You are able to pay to cast Venser using any combination of mana-producing creatures and/or creatures that can reduce its cost using convoke.
1636-3634-6972.description:
Cast Venser by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of creatures you can tap while casting it.
When Venser enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Venser trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-3634-6972.notes: If you control mana-producing creatures, you can tap those creatures for mana instead of tapping them using the convoke ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Sailor of Means

1409-3129-5424.description:
Activate Sailor of Means by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sailor of Means enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sailor of Means.
Resolve the Sailor of Means trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2366-5234-5702-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5234-5702-7060.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1339-6713.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional creature with flash and/or haste
997-1339-6713.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature with haste or flash.
When the creature dies, Shadow triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1202-1477-5660.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, targeting Evolution Witness.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it triggers, adding {C}.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Moonvessel by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

856-2267-5231-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4772-5742-5743.description:
Activate Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

977-1414-1594-2051-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two land cards in your hand.
977-1414-1594-2051-5751.description:
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Cast Chromatic Star from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {G}, returning at least two land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Chromatic Star by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Chromatic Star triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1978-2364-2416.description:
Animate Mana Vault using Rise and Shine.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat from step 2.

117-185-2104-2501-3098.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} on the first turn, with at most {6}{U}{U}{U} available each other extra turn
117-185-2104-2501-3098.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with power two or greater.
You have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn.
117-185-2104-2501-3098.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U} and sacrificing a creature with power two or greater, targeting yourself.
Temporal Manipulation's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Temporal Manipulation trigger, copying it, targeting yourself.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Temporal Manipulations, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your last extra turn.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing a Drake, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Call to Mind's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Call to Mind trigger, copying it, targeting Temporal Manipulation.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Call to Minds, returning Temporal Manipulation and Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U} and sacrificing a Drake, targeting Call to Mind.
Mystic Retrieval's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Retrieval trigger, copying it, targeting Temporal Manipulation.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, returning Temporal Manipulation and Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Repeat from step 7.

643-2034-3413.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Maskwood Nexus, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

1118-1769-2201-3983.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1118-1769-2201-3983.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Tattered Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Tattered Mummy die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Tattered Mummy and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Tattered Mummy trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 4.

776-1329-2593-4534.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-2593-4534.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Astral Cornucopia to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Astral Cornucopia.
Cast Astral Cornucopia.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
